# LinkedIn MCP

Local unofficial LinkedIn browser integration, package linkedin-mcp-tools.
Read README.md, docs/CAPABILITIES.md, docs/WORKFLOWS.md and docs/PRIVACY.md.
22 tools; the inventory is generated from src/tools/capabilities.ts.
Native structuredContent and matching JSON text; contract version 1.
Metadata gives source, fetchedAt, partial, status and evidenced pagination.
Current live availability is unknown. Offline fixtures do not establish it.

Use whoami for cold status and capability policy. health_check is a live read
unless safety state blocks it. --doctor is offline; --doctor --live is explicit.
Setup uses a local Chrome login, not pasted OAuth/cookie environment credentials.
Official OAuth is unavailable in the active runtime. No fallback grants access.

Writes are alpha and disabled by default. Preview with confirm omitted/false.
Only after the human approves exact target/content may you call confirm:true,
with the preview's operation ID and payload hash. Runtime opt-in is also required.
Return the status including unknown. Unknown completion requires manual inspection;
reuse the same operation ID for lookup. Never automatically resend, mass-message,
disable pacing or solve checkpoints. Stop automation on checkpoint signals.

Reads are bounded. No implicit pagination/crawl. Only use returned continuations
or explicitly supported offsets. DOM/inbox/conversation pages remain partial.
Chrome credentials and safety state stay local; MCP clients receive result data.
No telemetry is added. No current live/provider/hosted-matrix/growth claim follows
from this local checkout. See docs/ROADMAP_COVERAGE.md for remaining exit gates.
